brief.promise: Log daily habits and see a correct monthly summary.
brief.primaryUser: One person tracking their own habits on a laptop
brief.problem: A paper habit tracker never summarizes the month automatically.
brief.visualDirection: Plain single page, system font, a habit list and a summary table
brief.deployment: Local Node server listening on the PORT it is given
coreWorkflow: Mark a habit done for a date
mustHaves: Add habits and mark them done for a date
A monthly summary shows, per habit, days done and completion percent for that month
Entries persist in data/habits.json across server restarts
acceptanceScenarios: Adding a habit named Read shows Read in the habit list
Marking Read done for today shows Read checked for today
With 30 days of seeded history in which Read is done on 20 days, the summary for that month shows Read 20 of 30 days (67%)
constraints: Node 24, no runtime npm dependencies; tests use node:test
npm test runs only fast unit tests under test/

The seeded 30-day summary check is an end-to-end script, scripts/populated-summary.mjs, run as `node scripts/populated-summary.mjs`; it starts the server against seeded data and is not part of npm test

Owner-fixed delivery order: (1) server skeleton and JSON storage, delivered together with scripts/populated-summary.mjs as that feature's acceptance for the seeded 30-day scenario; (2) marking habits done; (3) the monthly summary page. The script cannot pass until marking and the summary page exist, so its proof is deferred to integration; do not move the script to a later feature

transcript.content: A tiny local habit log: add habits, mark them done per day, and a monthly summary page that is correct for a full month of history.
